messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — upstream released cert-manager 1.14.0 with patches for CVE-2026-xxxxx and a couple of dependency bumps. Need a lightweight upgrade + postpatch validation plan for staging -> canary -> prod.

maria: Ack. Do we know if there are RBAC changes in 1.14? Last time cert-manager added a clusterrole change and we had to update CRD owner references.

sam: From the changelog: one new permission for reading secrets in cert-manager-issuer-controller; likely just ClusterRole addition. I'll open a diff of the manifests.

kevin: Also flagging etcd compatibility. If cert-manager changes how it writes to secrets/annotations it could bump etcd txn sizes. We should run a txn-size smoke on staging.

sue: Kubelet note: cert rotation affects kubelet TLS bootstrap only if we flip certs; I don't expect kubelet API changes here but we'll monitor kubelet logs for kubelet cert fetch failures.

alex: Plan suggestion: 1) patch staging cluster with manifest + RBAC changes 2) run automated rbac-sanity and audit-log sampling 3) run kms-integration verification (sign/unwrap) 4) smoke workload with heavy cert issuance for 20 min 5) canary to subset of prod namespaces 6) full rollout.

maria: For audit-log sampling, we should capture 1h before and 1h after and grep for "cert-manager" and "secrets" to ensure no new privilege footprints. I can wire a Kibana dashboard query.

sam: KMS: cert-manager is configured to call our KMS when using external key encryption for TLS private keys. We need to test key access: deploy a test Issuer that uses the same KMS key and confirm Get/Decrypt logs.

kevin: I'll add an etcd litmus test: run a script that performs 200 concurrent cert writes (small payload) and check median and p95 txn size and latency. If p95 latency > 250ms or avg txn size increases >20% we pause.

alex: Good. Who can own smoke and rollback playbook? Need a primary and backup.

sue: I can own smoke tests and kubelet log monitoring during rollout window. @maria can own audit sampling.

maria: Yep, I'll do audit sampling and permission diff.

sam: I'll own manifest diffs and KMS test cluster. I'll post the PR and the test Issuer YAML.

ci-bot: CI job triggered: refs/heads/patch/cert-manager-1.14.0-diff — tests: rbac-lint, manifest-validate, integration-kms.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy started for cert-manager/1.14.0 at 2026-03-20T14:22Z (rolling).

alex: Preflight checklist (short):
- backup etcd snapshot (kevin)
- cluster-admin RBAC preview (sam)
- KMS access test and CloudTrail logs enabled (sam/maria)
- audit-logging window scheduled and dashboard ready (maria)
- smoke test harness deployed (sue)
- on-call rotation set (alex)

maria: Adding RBAC check command for reviewers:
```
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:cert-manager:cert-manager-controller -n cert-manager
kubectl diff -f deploy/rolebindings.yaml
```

sam: PR link: https://gitlab.redwood.ai/redwood/infrastructure/-/merge_requests/4242 — includes role/clusterrole diffs and a small KMS patch. Please review.

kevin: Etcd test script snippet:
```
# run 200 concurrent writes
python tests/etcd_txn_bench.py --concurrency 200 --duration 120
```

alex: If staging looks good for 30m, plan is canary to 10% prod namespaces (alpha, beta) for 2h, then 100% if no regressions. Rollback is helm rollback to previous cert-manager release and revoke recent Issuers if necessary.

sue: Smoke test actions: issue 50 certs across k8s services, curl each endpoint with TLS, verify cert SUBJECT and SANs, then force renewal and watch logs.

maria: Audit check postpatch: grep for "create secret" by cert-manager SA and look for any unexpected "create rolebinding"/"escalation" events. Also check KMS logs for Decrypt failures.

sam: Found one small manifest change that adds `verbs: ["get", "list"]` to a ClusterRole — low risk. Flagged in MR.

alex: Timebox: staging patch now, results in ~2h. Canary target tonight 23:00 UTC if staging green. If anything odd, we abort and escalate.

kevin: I'll run the etcd bench and post numbers here in ~20m.

ci-bot: rbac-lint passed. manifest-validate failed on missing CRD version in one CRD — sam pls fix.

sam: Fix pushed. Triggering CI again.

alex: Thanks. After canary, we'll run postpatch validation checklist and close the incident if no issues. If we see KMS Decrypt errors or audit surprises, we rollback immediately and open an incident. :eyes:

maria: I'll prepare a short postmortem template in case we need it: root cause, timeline, mitigation, followups.

sue: On-call is patched into the channel. I'll start smoke tests once ci-bot reports successful staging deploy.

kevin: Etcd bench numbers: median txn latency 42ms (baseline 38ms), p95 160ms (baseline 150ms), avg txn size +4%. All within our thresholds. Posting raw CSV to the infra bucket.

alex: Great. Keep this thread for rollout notes. Posting final go/no-go at 22:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for cert-manager to namespaces: alpha,beta at 2026-03-20T23:02Z.

maria: Audit sampling after canary shows no new rolebinding events and KMS logs show 0 decrypt failures. Looks clean so far.

sam: No runtime errors in cert-manager pods. Issuers issuing certs properly.

alex: Go for full rollout at 23:40 UTC unless anyone objects. :shipit:

sue: Running final smoke renewal now.

kevin: Monitoring etcd during full rollout.

maria: Postpatch audit run complete. Saving artifacts to #security-snapshots.

alex: Closing thread — thanks everyone. Will file followups for a long-term RBAC policy lint job and a scheduled KMS smoke every quarter.

maria: Thanks — adding followups to the security board.

sam: noted, will link MR and logs to the release notes.

ci-bot: Deployment summary: staging ✅, canary ✅, prod ✅. All checks passed."
